item.title: Goods train derails near Kavali station in Nellore, damages track and disrupts rail movement | VIDEO
item.description: A goods train derailed near Kavali Railway Station in Nellore district, leading to track damage and slight delays in train movement. Two wagons went off the rails while the train was travelling from Vijayawada to Tirupati. Railway officials quickly began restoration work to normalise services.

item.title: Pollution Ka Solution: Bhupender Yadav says 'recycle, reuse and reproduce' to protect environment
item.description: At 'Pollution Ka Solution Conclave', Union Minister for Environment, Bhupender Yadav, highlighted how forest conservation can reduce pollution and strengthen India’s fight against climate change.

item.title: Jana Nayagan: Supreme Court refuses interim relief to makers of Vijay’s movie in certification row
item.description: The Supreme Court of India has refused to grant interim relief to the producers of Vijay-starrer Jana Nayagan in the ongoing certification dispute. The court said the matter is scheduled to be heard by the High Court on January 20.

item.title: What happened in the Dhule Municipal Corporation in the last elections in 2018?
item.description: Dhule Municipal Corporation last went to polls in 2018, when the BJP won a clear majority in the 74-member civic body. Voter turnout stood at 61.49 per cent. The results of the 2026 Dhule municipal elections will be announced on January 16.

item.title: Adil Rashid, Rehan Ahmed unlikely to travel with T20 WC squad due to delay in visas: Report
item.description: Adil Rashid and Rehan Ahmed are of Pakistani heritage and the Indian government are yet to issue visas to them. Due to this, England's T20 World Cup squad which is also due to face Sri Lanka before the mega event, will travel without the two players for now.
